description: This file provides browser-native speech services, including Speech-to-Text (STT) via SpeechRecognition and Text-to-Speech (TTS) via SpeechSynthesis, with fallback handling for unsupported APIs.

methods.name: getSpeechRecognitionCtor
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate SpeechRecognition constructor based on browser support.

methods.name: isSttSupported
methods.description: Checks if Speech Recognition API is supported in the browser.

methods.name: startStt
methods.description: Starts speech recognition with provided callbacks.

methods.name: isSttActive
methods.description: Returns whether speech recognition is currently active.

methods.name: isTtsSupported
methods.description: Checks if Text-to-Speech API is supported in the browser.

methods.name: speakText
methods.description: Speaks the provided text with optional callbacks for start, end, and error events.

methods.name: isTtsSpeaking
methods.description: Returns whether speech synthesis is currently speaking.

methods.name: stripMarkdown
methods.description: Removes common markdown syntax from text for cleaner speech output.
